title: Audit 20 Admin IAM, competency, review and legal API contracts

spec.problem: The next 20 active Admin METHOD+PATH APIs lack route-by-route contract and auth verification; IAM roles/permissions list handlers appear to scan four/five columns from shorter SQL selections and silently omit every row.

acceptance.text: Test each of the first 20 REMAINING API METHOD+PATH entries beginning GET /api/admin/iam/permissions and ending PATCH /api/admin/legal/policies/{id}; assert response contract, authorization, and persistence/action where applicable using disposable fixtures.
Fix any reproducible local defects at their root and retain targeted regression tests; the full Go test-race/vet/architecture suite passes.

Visible Admin UI requests for the audited routes are observed where practical; use the actual Admin browser session and verify UI state for IAM, Competencies, Review, and Legal. IAM Roles and Permissions remain usable at 390px with keyboard-accessible horizontal table scrolling.

spec.expected_behavior: Each of the 20 inventoried API method/path entries returns its documented response and performs the expected persistence/action; anonymous or insufficient-role requests are denied; invalid input and missing resources return contract-consistent errors.
spec.observed_behavior: GET /api/admin/iam/roles selects four columns but scans five; GET /api/admin/iam/permissions selects three but scans four and silently ignores Scan errors. Remaining 18 paths have not yet been exercised in this wave.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert only AUDIT-158 regression tests and handler fixes; no canonical learning content or production records are modified. Use disposable local database fixtures and delete them after verification.
